sourceRef.entry: Deadly Aim: Dex 13, base attack bonus +1; trade ranged attack bonus for damage
Voluntary trade-off: -1 on all ranged attack rolls for +2 on all ranged damage rolls; never auto-applied
Point-Blank Shot: no prerequisites; +1 attack and damage on targets within 30 feet
Conditional +1 attack and damage within 30 feet; conditional bonus stays out of unconditional effects
Rapid Shot: Dex 13, Point-Blank Shot; one extra ranged attack
One additional ranged attack during a full attack at the highest bonus; all attacks take -2; the ranger combat style grant waives the prerequisites
